import os
import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,AVX::HELPER)
sys.path.insert(0,AVX::DEPENDENCIES)
import appviewx
import Decrypt_Python3 as Decrypt

scp_type = '<%scpType%>'


def serverScp():
    source_name = '<%sourceName%>'
    source_location =  '<%sourceLocation%>'
    destination_name = '<%destinationName%>'
    destination_location = '<%destinationLocation%>'
    username, password = Decrypt.getpassword(source_name)
    sourceDetails = AVX::JSONCONVERTER(source_name, '$$username$$', '$$password$$', source_location)
    username, password = Decrypt.getpassword(destination_name)
    destinationDetails = AVX::JSONCONVERTER(destination_name, '$$username$$', '$$password$$', destination_location)
    AVX::PUSH(str(source_name),sourceDetails,destinationDetails)
    output = {}
    output["Implement"] = AVX::CONFIG
    AVX::OUTPUT(output)
    
    
def deviceScp():
    scp_file = '<%scpFile%>'
    device_name = '<%deviceList%>'
    username, password = Decrypt.getpassword(device_name)
    destination_location = '<%destinationLocation%>'
    destinationDetails = AVX::JSONCONVERTER(device_name, '$$username$$', '$$password$$', destination_location)
    AVX::PUSH("N/A","None", destinationDetails ,"sftp", scp_file)
    output = {}
    output["Implement"] = AVX::CONFIG
    AVX::OUTPUT(output)



if __name__ == "__main__":
    if scp_type == "Server to Server":
        serverScp()
    elif scp_type == "To Device":
        deviceScp()
    else:
        output = {}
        AVX::CMD("NA" +':@'+ 'command')
        output["Implement"] = AVX::CONFIG
        AVX::OUTPUT(output)
